title: Mik-Nana Food Scale Pink, 10kg/22lb Digital Kitchen Scale Weight Grams and Oz for Baking and Cooking, 1g/0.1oz Precise Graduation, Easy Clean Stainless Steel
description:
About this item
【Precise Weight】22lb capacity, 1g resolution, the digital food scale with built-in four high-precision load sensors provide more accurate measurements and instant readings.
【Multifunction Scale】This digital kitchen scale has 6 measurement unit to meet all the food weight that you need: g, kg, lb, oz, ml, milk ml. Big bright LCD display easy to read.
【Easy Tare】Convenient tare button for tare calculation allows you to subtract the weight of plate or container, making it easy to achieve accurate readouts of ingredients. This digital weight scale is for better cooking, baking, tracking intake, weight loss and postage.
【Compact Sleek】Stainless-steel digital scale is designed with food-grade 304 stainless-steel platform for easy cleaning and maintenance, the digital kitchen scale’s convenient size makes it easy to store in your kitchen.
【Great Support】2 AAA batteries included. Our products are rigorously tested and made with love. For any issues, please reach to us, we stand behind our kitchen scales.
